title: Study of Viral Load and Maternal-fetal Serology in the Interpretation of the Vertical Transmission of SARS Cov-2 (COVID-19) During Pregnancy
brief_summary: The study evaluates the distribution of immunological and virological profiles of newborns patients. Mothers of these children have a proven infection to SARS Cov-2 during pregnancy.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* pregnant woman
* diagnosed with Sars Cov-2 during pregnancy
* singleton or twin pregnancy
* informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* virological or serological samples not done the day of delivery
